_note: Juniper 'Your adds' (Tiffany Nov 7 8:24pm, docs/ANSWERS.md): five OMM mats she added. Built with JUNIPER_ORDER_START=54, rows appended to assets/cards/juniper/manifest.json. Photos: OMM full-size flat product shots (Anastasia, Hampton, Lorelei from products.json; Darjeeling from OMM's CDN, product gone from the store = retired; Birdie Green = our retired OMM asset assets/mats/omm-retired/birdie-green.jpg).

mats.name: Lorelei
mats.why: Your add: a pagoda match, and very cute. The pinks, lime greens and teals are all there; no forest green, but a lot of colour range in the greens.

mats.name: Darjeeling
mats.why: Your add ("How could we forget?!"): the pagoda ties in, and while the tiles are brighter than Darjeeling, it has the greens. The mat is a chameleon with its infusion of bright blue and a pink inner border. Retired.
mats.photo_src: OMM CDN darjeeling-mat-312731.jpg (flat, 2400x3000); product page gone

mats.name: Anastasia
mats.why: Your add: a pink centre for her pink faces and a turquoise-and-teal frame for her layers, with leafy blossom branches; the blue band and peach lattice are extra colours, and there's no forest green.

mats.name: Hampton
mats.why: Your add: chartreuse and mint like her layers, pink brushstrokes and pagoda lanterns, though the blue lanterns and cranes make it lighter and sunnier than her forest-green backs.

mats.name: Birdie Green
mats.why: Your add: the deep green frame and kelly centre carry her Forest Green Jade backs, and the blue-and-teal peacocks pick up her teal layer; almost no pink, so the faces bring it. Retired.

_racks: Mat racks follow her earlier album picks for these mats where they exist (config/album-rack-picks.json: Lorelei French Blue + Light Pink, Anastasia Hot Pink + Turquoise Blue, Hampton Teal + Lime Green); Darjeeling + Birdie Green = matpick (French Blue + Kelly Green, Forest Green + Periwinkle Blue). Tile racks (OMM Hot Pink + Agate) are never repeated on the mat side.
